notes.title: Performance Boost Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hi everyone! 👋[/h2]

As we finish porting Toasterball to a little console from Nintendo ([i]stay tuned for more info on that[/i] 👀), we had to do all sorts of [b]optimizations[/b] that we decided to bring to the PC version too, so that our friends with smaller configs could enjoy Toasterball with a crisps 60 FPS as well 😀

Here are the small changes we made to this version:

[h3]1. Performance boost[/h3]
We upgraded the asynchronous [b]loading[/b] at the begining of the game to make it look smoother and reduce the time between the moment you click "Play" in Steam and the app launches.

We also did a lot ([i]like... a month's worth of work[/i]) of [b]invisible optimizations[/b] to our materials and lighting to make them run smoother ([i]went from 25 to 60 FPS on that little console for example[/i]). Visually, basic shaders didn't change at all (well... apart for the fact that it runs way faster), but you might notice a slight change in the shadow system. We opted for a custom shading technique and had to remove the default Unity hard shadows that used to be applied everywhere. We replaced them with custom soft shadows below the toasters, the toasts and the ball. It might be less visible than before, but it's closer to the cartoonish style we had in mind for the game, it's way faster to run, and also better for gameplay readability!

[h3]2. Addition of traditional chinese[/h3]
We also added the traditional chinese language in-game, in achievements descriptions and on the store page (another cool side-effect of our port).

Enjoy! 🔥

[b]Les Crafteurs,[/b]
[i]Alex, Simon, Joris & Théo[/i]

notes.title: TOASTERBALL’S FULL VERSION IS FINALLY AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/8695ea0a4ac5b3b9591ab0c48a66a5bed011875d.png[/img][h3]Since Wednesday, May 3rd at 10am UTC, [b]a big update is available on your Steam launcher![/b][/h3]

It offers a significant number of additions, like [b]new maps[/b], a [b]custom mode[/b], or the ability to [b]play against AI![/b] In fact, it's almost [i]Toasterball 2[/i], but [b]FREE[/b]! [i](well, for those who had already purchased the game in early access, of course, let’s not exaggerate)[/i]

We've already talked about it in the devlogs [i]([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1142810/announcements/detail/3604599522841343612]here[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1142810/announcements/detail/3683415686323339703]here[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1142810/announcements/detail/3672159223618326284]here[/url])[/i],  but we decided to do like the grown up devs do and detail all these new features of the [b]final version[/b] here!

[quote][i]We recommend that you stay until the end, there's a little surprise! (No really.)
(AND DON'T CHEAT, I SEE YOU THERE STARTING TO SCROLL)[/i][/quote]
[previewyoutube=7KS7p5TQTKI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New features[/h2]

[h3]Launch intro[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new logo animation for [b]Les Crafteurs[/b] [i](formerly known as Couch Game Crafters)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Main Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the Athletes Menu
[*] Overall UI revision
[/list]
[h3]Lobby[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial with pictures on the whiteboard
[*] Updated "How to Play?" video
[/list]
[h3]Classic Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] New team and role selection menu [i](attack/defense)[/i]
[*] Ability to add AI-controlled athletes and play solo with/against them
[*] New map selection menu, with 4 new maps and an update to the original Stadium
[/list]
[h3]Custom Mode[/h3]

[i]A new mode to fully customize your game sessions:[/i]
[list]
[*] Variants selection, chosen in order or randomly
[*] Map selection, chosen in order or randomly
[*] Rules customization [i](points to win, doors & toaster HP)[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/81d4fb41963e09ff9f1e7cc969cdb68475093835.gif[/img]

[h3]During play[/h3]
[list]
[*] New VS screen with athlete background
[*] New intro cinematics for each map, with dedicated music
[*] Changed goals: a system of three breakable panels for more intense and balanced matches
[*] Polished physics [i](jumps and toaster movements)[/i]
[*] Polished ball behavior [i](acceleration over time)[/i]
[*] New replay system [i](with multiple controllable cameras)[/i]
[*] [b]A lot of new variants[/b] [i](we'll let you discover them yourself, hehe)[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/096a419ad5e49ebee7376402a5351ea24f49bd84.gif[/img]

[h3]Athletes Menu[/h3]
[list]
[*] Display of each athlete attributes [i](description, locker, background)[/i]
[*] You’ll finally be able to see the back of the toasters
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/2ce34bbd3072602fdb4a39ff8bd1b4bde235e517.png[/img]

[h3]Options[/h3]
[list]
[*] 8 new languages available [i](plus a really special one)[/i]
[*] UI options
[*] AI difficulty slider
[*] New secret codes
[*] New sound settings and volume test
[/list]
[h3]Credits[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated credits page[i] (addition of adorable & awesome people)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]General UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed mouse control
[*] Added buttons to hold down to navigate menus
[*] New loading screens
[*] Steam Cloud Saving
[*] Removal of Tikhon 
[/list]
[h3]Steam[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a ton of achievements
[*] Added collectible cards
[/list]

[quote]We really hope you’ll enjoy this update and that it will be an opportunity to do some crazy tournaments![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/722df3e8b8637782e410d3c18673e88ca7911ad2.gif[/img]

[h2]Help us get the word out![/h2]

This is all great, but now [b]we need the world to notice us[/b]! 
And that's where [b][u]you[/u][/b] come in!

After getting your copy of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1142810/Toasterball/][b]Toasterball[/b][/url], please don't hesitate to leave us a [b]positive review[/b]. Steam seems to [i]LOVE[/i] that.
And of course, if money’s tight and you can’t buy the game right now, feel free to [b]add the game to your wishlist![/b] It doesn't cost anything and it also helps us a lot to gain visibility on Steam!


[h2]Thank you[/h2]

[b]Toasterball[/b] has been with us for 5 and a half years now. This project has taught us so much and still has the power to surprise us, to bring us amazing experiences and crazy opportunities.

As our first game, you can imagine the immense relief and pride we feel in finally delivering it to you and sharing it with the world.

[b]Thank you again for your support, kindness, and enthusiasm.[/b]

The next step for us will be to [strike]sleep for a few days[/strike] port [b]Toasterball[/b] to the [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], and then start working on a new project that we can't wait to share with you!

notes.title: Toasterball 1.6.0: Electric Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=40vEck6Cn8E;full][/previewyoutube]


Here are the new features on this little update:


[h1]1. New variant:  Electric Slabs ⚡💡[/h1]
[i]Description:[/i] Try not to get electrocuted! There’s a moving light bulb on the ceiling, and electric slabs on the floor. Every few seconds, an electric arc will appear between a random slab and the bulb, creating a deadly laser that you must avoid or you will explode! [b]Yay, electrical hazard![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/a3c320f4d524efbb62ac1834712a614e25517363.png[/img]


[h1]2. Dynamic music system 🎶[/h1]
We added a [b]new dynamic music system[/b], that will add little varieties to the music depending of the variant you are in. Not all variants are covered but we tried it on the pong one (with an 8bits version of the main theme) and the ice one.


[h1]3. Secret codes 🎁[/h1]
We implemented a secret code system you can access via the options menu. This will allow us to put secret [b]unlockable stuff[/b] like toasters of your favorite twitch streamers, or secret modes to unlock. For now, let’s just say there’s little surprise in the dev letter on the start menu! (Also join our Discord for more codes!)


[h1]4. Other cool things[/h1]
And then there’s the usual stuff: [b]bug fixes, little tweaks[/b] on the physics system, etc. Amongst other things, here’s what we did:
[list]
[*] Fixed the basketball variant bug where the ball could go though the hoop and not trigger a goal,
[*] Added more bounce to the basketball so it’s easier to score,
[*] The ball will now accelerate way more as the point goes on,
[*] The ball should not get stuck sliding on the pong paddle anymore,
[*] The “Claustrophobia” variant (ceiling of death) should now last a little bit longer,
[*] The bomb ball will now explode faster and faster.
[/list]
